title: 10th Annual Strategic Indirect Tax, VAT Management and e-Invoicing Summit
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
Join Vertex at the 10th Annual Strategic Indirect Tax, VAT Management and E-Invoicing Summit in Amsterdam on 9–10 September 2026. The event brings together senior tax leaders from global organizations to explore the latest developments in indirect tax, VAT compliance, e-invoicing and tax technology.


As a Premium Sponsor, Vertex is excited to be part of the conversations shaping the future of tax. From mandatory e-invoicing and digital transformation to AI-driven tax processes and evolving regulatory requirements, the summit offers practical insights, real-world experiences and valuable networking opportunities with leading tax professionals.


If you're looking to simplify compliance, reduce risk and turn tax into a strategic advantage, meet the Vertex team at the event. Register today and discover how modern tax technology can help your organization stay ahead of change.


For more information, please visit:[https://tbmgroup.eu/etn/10th-annual-strategic-indirect-tax-and-vat-management-summit/](https://tbmgroup.eu/etn/10th-annual-strategic-indirect-tax-and-vat-management-summit/)
